name: Goodhart in the Planner
summary: Measures reward hacking when a sampling-based planner (MPPI or best-of-N) searches against a reward model learned from human preferences, by tracking true return as search pressure increases.
numbers: Harder search cuts true return by up to 76%; Meta-World drawer-open with human labels 0/20 vs 10/10 for the starting policy, label accuracy 0.75–0.97

why.dex: Continuous control of locomotion and an arm.
why.xr: Reward hacking on a robot controller that held-out label accuracy does not reveal, with no harm scenario.
